description: DAO-PROP: on TableDef T, a detached Property from CreateProperty() with no arguments (Name/Type/Value read), initialised to P1/Text/'', appended; a duplicate P1 appended; Type changed after append; Value set to 7, Null, Empty, each read back; Delete('P1') twice with the held Property read after; same-name recreation as Long 9 with the old handle read. A field property FP and a change to the database property CalcDbProbe. Then Close, a read-only reopen, and the reopened P1, FP and CalcDbProbe values. Errors after each failure.
retentionNote: Designed r-dao-1-err-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
